text: {"final": {"summary": "Created scripts/resend_failed_sms.py (P1): it reads data/sms_status.json to identify failed vs. delivered messages, loads the original messages from data/outbox/sms.jsonl, and re-sends exactly one new SMS per failed message to the same household with the same template, params, and text by reusing notifications/sms.queue_sms (which resolves the household's phone via the registry). It appends sms_resend audit entries to data/audit.jsonl matching the existing pattern, and is idempotent (skips already re-sent messages). Ran it once (P2): 9 failed messages (SMS-00001, 03, 05, 08, 10, 11, 12, 14, 16) were re-sent as SMS-00017 through SMS-00025 to their original households. Built-in verification confirmed each failed household received exactly one new text with the same message and no delivered household was texted.", "done_steps": ["P1", "P2"]}}
